name: reply-in-thread
description: Replies in a Slack message thread, optionally also showing the reply in the channel. Takes the channel by name or id (list-channels lists them) and the ts of the message replied to, which read-channel-history, read-thread and post-message answer.

channel.description: A channel name, with or without the leading #, or a channel id from list-channels.

threadTs.description: The ts of the message to reply to, from read-channel-history, read-thread or post-message.

text.description: The reply text in Slack mrkdwn.

alsoSendToChannel.description: Also show the reply in the channel. Defaults to false.
